findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:523: formatReviewEscalationFailure still opens with "first REVIEW round recorded multiple countable reviewer problems" even when the new explicitHighRiskPolicy path is the sole trigger and countableProblems is 0. WHY: B-963c adds explicitlyConfiguredHighRiskPolicyRequires3x2 as an independent DONE escalation trigger, so a policy-only block now produces a false root-cause message; operators following the failure text may chase reviewer findings that do not exist. Severity: medium.
